records.note: Eventual-approval call by analogy to flibanserin. A coder who applies 'of course' as an A phrase to the approval itself would code bin A. No time words in the quote ('eventually' is the finder's paraphrase), so the item is undated and takes the 24-month window from 2024-06-26.
